decisions.reason: The source explicitly relocates the Unit 3 drain and shower; it does not change Unit 1 toilet placement or drain alignment.
The source is specific to the Unit 3 bathroom and does not alter Unit 2 fixture placement or its bathroom-door position.
Relocating the Unit 3 bathroom drain and shower does not necessarily change the kitchen-counter arrangement or bathroom-door clearance strategy.
The bathroom fixture relocation does not change the number, dimensions, or open-plan configuration of the kitchen cabinets.
The Unit 3 bathroom modification does not affect whether the balcony is retained or incorporated into the adjacent room.
The bathroom drain and shower relocation does not alter the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source does not revise the general wall-preservation policy or any existing red, turquoise, or purple marked-wall action; its corridor wall shift is already owned by the corridor requirement.
The corridor effect is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY that moves the adjacent room wall by 10 cm; no edit is required.
The bathroom fixture relocation does not change the furnished drawing format or the furnishings and appliances that must be shown.
The Unit 3 bathroom modification does not alter Unit 1's 2+1 room program.
